g.env.weather.timer=9999; const p=g.world.place('landing'); P.place(p.x,p.z,p.face||0); P.tool='rod'; g.viewmodel.setTool('rod'); window.__until=async(fn,ms=120000)=>{ const t0=performance.now(); while(performance.now()-t0<ms){ const r=fn(); if(r) return r; await new Promise(q=>setTimeout(q,50)); } return null; }; window.__frames=async(n)=>{ for(let i=0;i<n;i++) await new Promise(r=>requestAnimationFrame(()=>r())); }; window.__dotAt=(wx,wz)=>{ const S=g.screens, v=S.mapView, c=S.mapCanvas, r=c.getBoundingClientRect(); const k=r.width/c.width; const x=r.left+((wx-v.cx)*v.scale+c.width/2)*k, y=r.top+((wz-v.cz)*v.scale+c.height/2)*k; let d=document.getElementById('__tapdot'); if(!d){ d=document.createElement('div'); d.id='__tapdot'; d.style.cssText='position:fixed;width:2px;height:2px;pointer-events:none;z-index:999'; document.body.appendChild(d); } d.style.left=(x-1)+'px'; d.style.top=(y-1)+'px'; return Math.round(x)+','+Math.round(y); }; window.__panTo=(wx,wz)=>{ const S=__rhf.game.screens, v=S.mapView, c=S.mapCanvas, r=c.getBoundingClientRect(); const k=r.width/c.width; const px=r.left+((wx-v.cx)*v.scale+c.width/2)*k, py=r.top+((wz-v.cz)*v.scale+c.height/2)*k; const mx=r.left+r.width/2, my=r.top+r.height/2; let dx=mx-px, dy=my-py; if(Math.hypot(dx,dy)<20) return null; dx=Math.max(-0.8*r.width,Math.min(0.8*r.width,dx)); dy=Math.max(-0.8*r.height,Math.min(0.8*r.height,dy)); const a=[mx-dx/2,my-dy/2,mx+dx/2,my+dy/2]; const e=document.elementFromPoint(a[0],a[1]); if(e!==c) return 'the drag would start on '+(e?(e.id||e.tagName):'nothing')+', not the map'; return a; }; window.__boxes=(ids)=>ids.map(id=>{ const e=document.getElementById(id); if(!e||e.hidden||e.offsetParent===null) return id+' hidden'; const r=e.getBoundingClientRect(); return id+' '+Math.round(r.left)+','+Math.round(r.top)+' '+Math.round(r.width)+'x'+Math.round(r.height); }).join(' | '); window.__overlap=(a,b)=>{ const A=document.getElementById(a).getBoundingClientRect(), B=document.getElementById(b).getBoundingClientRect(); return !(A.right<=B.left||B.right<=A.left||A.bottom<=B.top||B.bottom<=A.top); }; return 'at '+p.name; })()

steps.label: not running at first; money, cooler, minimap and RUN are on screen and none overlap
